feeds.title: My Money Chronicles
feeds.description: My Money Chronicles is a personal finance and lifestyle blog that focuses on side hustles, travel, motivation, and money tips. It's designed to help people take control of their finances through practical advice, inspiring stories, and real-life experiences. The site shares insights on paying off debt, earning extra income, and exploring the world, all while staying motivated and focused on financial goals.

feeds.title: Ask The Money Coach
feeds.description: The free financial blog of Lynnette Khalfani-Cox, The Money Coach®. Learn how to improve your credit, create a budget and pay off your credit card debt.

feeds.title: Madam Money Blog
feeds.description: Tarra Jackson takes the complication and intimidation out of Personal Financial and Business Breakthroughs. Tarra, nationally recognized economic empowerment speaker, syndicated financial blogger, radio commentator, author and an authority on personal finance and business success, helps Entrepreneurs & WannaBePreneurs with starting and/or enhancing their business.

feeds.title: Yes, I Am Cheap Blog
feeds.description: A little blog about reducing debt, growing income and learning about personal finance.

feeds.title: It'$ My Money Blog
feeds.description: Patrina Dixon is a Personal Finance Expert, International Speaker, and #1 best-selling author of the top-selling financial journal book series, 'It'$ My Money. Patrina is a distinguished 2018 One Hundred Women of Color Alumni. As an advocate for financial literacy and passion for serving her community, she uses her company, P. Dixon Consulting to offer money management strategies to individuals of varying ages.

feeds.title: Money Talk with Tiff Blog
feeds.description: The financial help you need! A finance blog dedicated to show you how to live below your means now so you can retire comfortably later.

feeds.title: Black Real Estate Agents
feeds.description: Connecting Black Real Estate Agents with Home Owners and Sellers.

feeds.title: Reluctant Frugalist
feeds.description: This blog is a way for me to explore the topic more fully, and to write about my journey towards financial independence.

feeds.title: Pocket of Money Blog
feeds.description: Pocket of Money, LLC provides information and resources for individuals and businesses ready to make significant progress toward financial success. We provide consulting, courses, training, and resources to help you optimize your income, grow your savings, eliminate debt, and build wealth.

feeds.title: My Debt Epiphany Blog
feeds.description: I'm Choncé, a personal finance expert and professional writer who helps ambitious millennials and Generation Z, recent college grads, and want-to-be entrepreneurs get unstuck by regaining control of their money so they can live a life with more possibilities and fewer limitations.

feeds.title: Mint Worthy Co Blog
feeds.description: Mint Worthy was created to change the way women relate to money and to empower them to step into a life of financial freedom. Our goal is to get you back in control over every part of your life, starting with your finances. Read articles on how to manage your money, budget, savings, and debt repayment plan, and achieve financial success.

feeds.title: Finances On Point Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! My name is Stephanie, the creator of Finances On Point. I created Finances On Point as your go-to resource to ask questions and find solutions to optimize your personal economy so that you can pursue financial independence.

feeds.title: H&H Wealth Management » Personal Finance
feeds.description: Zaneilia Harris shares insightful and resourceful articles where she covered a wide variety of important topics related to personal finance and she also talks about successful investing. She empowers women in every stage of their lives and careers with the guidance to craft savvy, strategic, and sustainable plans for their financial futures.

feeds.title: Arts and Budgets Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Latasha! Welcome! I am so glad you are here. I help creatives earn extra money from side hustles and create their financial dream life in a fun and innovative way. Find different posts about how to make money from side hustles and posts about how to save and budget effectively in this section.

feeds.title: Black Girl Finance » Money Tips
feeds.description: Black Girl Finance has been created to fill a gap in the personal development space for black women. Managing money can often be put on the back burner because life is busy and we have to juggle so many different responsibilities. That is why we have created this Jargon-free, no-nonsense money blog.

feeds.title: rich & REGULAR Blog
feeds.description: We, Julien and Kiersten Saunders started rich & REGULAR in 2017 to help people who are doing everything right but still not getting results. Our blog is a place where we not only share people's frustration but offer solutions to a richer and happier life, pursue financial independence, and plan for paying off debt, improving credit, and investing.

feeds.title: Clever Girl Finance Blog
feeds.description: Voted one of the top personal finance websites for women, Clever Girl Finance is a financial education platform aimed at providing women with financial guidance that will inspire them to pursue and achieve their dreams of financial independence.

feeds.title: News Moves Markets Forex » Black News
feeds.description: Latest breaking black news, including finance, economic development, politics, culture, business, and social issues impacting black communities.

feeds.title: My Fab Finance Blog
feeds.description: My Fab Finance is an award-winning personal finance site dedicated to helping millennial women change their money story and become their own fabulous. Follow this blog as we help you become financially free so you can do more of what you love.

feeds.title: The Frugal Feminista Blog
feeds.description: FF is a rapidly growing source for personal finance, lifestyle, and all things financial empowerment, girl power & juicy living!

feeds.title: Popcorn Finance Blog
feeds.description: Learning how to invest, pay down debt, and reach your financial goals doesn't have to be complicated or take forever! That's why each week on Popcorn Finance I will break down all you need to know about your personal finances. From what is a stock, to how is your credit score calculated. We cover it all in about the time it takes to make a bag of popcorn.

feeds.title: I Am Melody Wright » Personal Finances
feeds.description: Broke on Purpose is here to provide help to those ready to take back control of their finances. We offer Personal Finance Consultations that will help learn to create a budget, come up with a plan in which you'll win at paying off debt, and set long-term financial goals that will ultimately lead you to building wealth.

feeds.title: Finances Demystified Blog
feeds.description: Financial tips and advice, freebies, motivation and real action steps to bring your Dreams2Reality from Dominique Broadway, Personal Finance Expert.

feeds.title: His & Her Money
feeds.description: Learn how to get out of debt, budget, build wealth, save money, how to blog, make money, side hustles, life, marriage advice, and tips.

feeds.title: The Money Speakeasy Blog
feeds.description: We're your social outlet to talk about taboo money topics many of us have questions about, like budgeting, debt, savings, credit, housing, insurance & more.

feeds.title: Debt Free Gonnabe Blog
feeds.description: It's Nika. I side hustle my ass off to slay over $200,000 worth of debt on my way to living the life I want and know I deserve. It is my hope that by sharing the good, bad, and ugly of this journey with you, I can inspire and motivate you to get serious and get focused on your own finances and future.

feeds.title: Makala Green Blog
feeds.description: On my blog, you will understand what wealth-building strategies to adopt, how to manage financial well-being, set goals, spot opportunities, and much more. Your personal finance blog will help you get on track with your finances regardless of where you are on your journey.

feeds.title: Well Balanced Wallet
feeds.description: My name is Kamika and I would like to welcome you to Well Balanced Wallet. My goal is to help you reach financial freedom and pass on healthy money habits to the next generation. Look around and let me know if you have any questions. We're in this together!

feeds.title: Sugar and Money Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jackie, the ever-optimistic, dreamer, planner, and lifetime learner behind Sugar and Money. I am so determined to pay off the last of my debt that I am crazy enough to document the journey for whoever is interested to see. I hope to show that becoming debt free is totally possible but definitely a conscious choice that has to be made constantly.

feeds.title: The Master Playbook
feeds.description: Holly D. Reid, CPA is an award-winning author, speaker, and Certified Financial Education Instructor. I am a Certified Public Accountant and an experienced finance professional. As a personal finance advocate, I am dedicated to helping adults and the next generation manage their finances as responsible stewards.

feeds.title: Tela Holcomb Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Tela. I'm not a stockbroker. I'm simply an ambitious mom and wife who will stop at nothing to build a legacy of wealth for my family without hustling so much that I never get to spend time with the people who matter most to me. I am a straight-talking success igniter who pushes people to propel past their most unimaginable dreams.

feeds.title: The Frugal Creditnista Blog
feeds.description: Netiva 'The Frugal CrediTnista' Heard is a Wife, Mother, Financial Empowerment Speaker, and more. Her mission is to Educate, Equip and Empower women and couples across the globe with the solutions they need to confidently & permanently Transform their finances.

feeds.title: Life and a Budget » Money
feeds.description: Life and a Budget is created to help women and their families create better finances while enjoying a little carefree living! I'm a Certified Financial Education Instructor (CFEI), freelance writer, goal chasing, mama to two kids.

feeds.title: She Makes Cents
feeds.description: Hello, Lovelies! I'm Danielle. She Makes Cents is a personal finance & lifestyle blog for women that transforms & inspires ways to use your 'cents' to live a fab life. Join me and the #SMCmoneytribe on the journey to accomplish financial goals, crush career barriers, and live a fabulous lifestyle all while working toward financial freedom.

feeds.title: Wealth Noir
feeds.description: I'm Damien. I'm the founder of Wealth Noir. I'm a dad, a former Facebook product manager, an MIT alum, MBA, and a self-proclaimed personal finance nerd. Wealth Noir is all about helping professional black millennials achieve financial freedom and generational wealth.

feeds.title: Magnify Money News
feeds.description: Magnify Money's free tools find the lowest credit card interest rates, the cheapest personal loans and the best cash back credit cards and savings accounts. We strive to promote transparency and financial empowerment, so everyone is a well-informed bank, credit card and credit union customer. Discover the best financial products for you!

feeds.title: Paychecks & Balances Blog
feeds.description: Paychecks and Balances is a fun and informative personal finance podcast and blog for working professionals on topics covering career, money, and life.

feeds.title: Money Chat
feeds.description: Dorethia is passionate about helping individuals successfully manage their money and business owners increase their bottom line. She speaks to youth and adults in areas of money management and business with #MoneyChatLIVE workshops and live events.

feeds.title: The Budgetnista Blog
feeds.description: Tiffany 'The Budgetnista' Aliche, is an award-winning teacher of financial education, America's favorite, personal financial educator, and author of the New York Times Bestselling book. Follow her blog to learn about tips and tricks to save money in a really effective and consistent way. She also gives us in-depth knowledge about the world of finance and money.

feeds.title: Woman & Finance Blog
feeds.description: Woman & Finance is a platform that educates and inspires women to take charge of their finances. We empower our clients with financial tools, tips, workshops & webinars.
